What is the postcode of the address we have on file for you?

intents.hardship: Financial hardship: job loss, illness, cannot cover essentials.
intents.dispute: "This isn't my debt" or "I never had that product".
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I'm Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. You can check this call by phoning Glenmorrow Savings Bank on the number on your card or in online banking.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only discuss the reason for my call once I've confirmed who I'm speaking with.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back between 9 am and 6:30 pm, today or on the next two business days. Is there another time that would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We'll call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry to have bothered you. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: We ask these questions to protect your information and make sure we only speak with you.
lines.id_explain: I can't continue without confirming your identity, because that keeps your details safe.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I'm unable to continue without confirming your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity, so I can't continue. Please visit a branch or use online banking.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account with us.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} in arrears, and it is {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay both in full today?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that is still below what I can accept.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That isn't a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day would you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {deadline}, so I've used that date.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take two business days to show, so I won't ask for a payment on your {name}.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask for a payment on your {name} today.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear you're going through this. I'm passing you to our care team, who can help.
lines.hardship_short: Shall I put you through now?
lines.restructure_line: I'll pass you to our arrears solutions team, who can talk about payment plans.
lines.human_ask_help: I can help with most things on this call. Is there something I can help you with?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change a promise once it's been saved on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

assumptions: The memo (19 Oct 2026, effective 2 Nov 2026) overrides policy v3.2 wherever they differ, as both the memo and Morag's email say. The memo also overrides the old dialler code list.
Memo A: the early band is now 1-14 days and the mid band 15-30 days. The late band (31-60) is unchanged. Each band keeps its deadline and number of attempts (early 1, mid 2, late 3).
Memo B: Friday 11 Dec 2026 is a non-business day and is added to the holidays. It is skipped when counting business days, and no promise or callback may fall on it.
Rule 11: 24 Dec 2026 is a normal business day, so it is not in the holidays list.
Memo C: the reason code 'refused' is retired. 'declined' is used as both the close_call reason and the add_note reason, and the tool API enums agree.
Memo D: the callback window is 09:00-18:30 inclusive, replacing 09:00-20:00. A callback can be today or on one of the next two business days, must be later than now, and must fall on a business day.
The memo keeps the 30% floor (rule 17) and the limit of two wrong identity answers in total (rule 9).

Floor = 30% of arrears_amount, rounded up to the next whole pound. A result that is already a whole number of pounds is not rounded further. Examples: £100.00 gives £30; £101.00 gives £30.30, which becomes £31. monthly_payment is never used or quoted.

If the rounded-up floor would be more than arrears_amount (only possible for very small debts), the floor is capped at the full arrears_amount, because rule 18 only accepts amounts between the floor and arrears_amount.
get_account gives amounts in pounds (amount_scale 1). create_promise takes whole pence (promise_scale 100, so £87.50 is sent as 8750).

Rule 20 counts the opening ask (full amount today) as attempt 1, so opening_is_attempt is true. The early band's one attempt is the opening ask alone. The mid band adds step 2, and the late band adds steps 2 and 3.
With two products, a flat no to 'pay both in full today' counts as step 1 for each product (rule 23).
Ladder step 2 is the full amount on the 5th business day after today, or on the deadline if that is earlier. The engine is assumed to clamp offer dates to the product's deadline.

Rule 21: if the customer says the full amount is too much, the next step offers the floor on that step's date and uses an attempt. This is modelled as too_much_floor 'attempt_1' with ladder step 2 set to full_or_floor.

Mid-band deadline = today + 14 calendar days, moved back to the previous business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday (rule 14). Late-band deadline = the last business day of the current month, or of the next month if today is already that day.

A promise date must be today or later, on a business day, and no later than the product's deadline. For a non-business day the agent offers the next business day, or the deadline if that is earlier. For a date after the deadline it offers the deadline (rule 15).
Date of birth is sent as DDMMYYYY (%d%m%Y). Postcode is sent in capitals with one space before the last three characters. Postcode length is left unset because UK postcodes vary in length.

The verify_identity response has no hint field (its fields are ok, error, verified, wrong_answers_left and all_verified), so response.hint is empty and hints is empty. An unreadable answer comes back as ok=false and is not counted as wrong.

Hardship: the agent says one sentence of sympathy and tells the customer they are being passed to the care team. The call transfers to queue care_team and closes as handoff/care. No note is written, because rule 29 forbids notes on any transfer. transfer_support maps to the same care_team transfer.
Restructure and human transfers write no notes. Promises already recorded stay. The call closes as handoff with that transfer's reason.
The no_ptp reason is the note reason of the first product, in get_account order, that was not noted 'paid'.
The payment-link SMS was dropped and is out of scope, so sms_line is empty.
The brief does not say how 'next Friday' is read, so the default 'following_week' is used.
The brief does not say how a numeric-only date is read. 'dmy' is used, which matches the bank's day-month-year format.
The brief does not cover changing a recorded promise, so the agent says it cannot be changed on this call.
The brief does not define 'I don't want to talk', so the default max_not_talk of 2 is used.
The brief does not say what happens to a product outside 1-60 days in arrears, so bands_outside is null.
Asking what the call is about instead of answering a security question counts as declining (the default). Rule 10 allows one explanation, and a second refusal closes as id_fail/declined_id.
The brief gives no name for the floor, so it is spoken as 'minimum amount'.
The policy's 'the call is recorded' is spoken in active voice: 'We record this call.'
